title: House Choice Ceremony
prompt:
Rhea presides over the formal choice ceremony. Edelgard, Dimitri, and Claude stand in separated visual zones, each with distinct energy: Edelgard composed and political, Dimitri sincere and dutiful, Claude relaxed and watchful. Byleth's attention slowly settles toward Dimitri. Preserve all three leaders' academy-phase youth and identity.

Camera: wide ceremonial hold with a subtle focus pull toward Dimitri. Rhea must remain a breathtakingly beautiful young adult woman in her mid-20s with smooth youthful skin; express ancient dragon divinity through calm sacred authority, not wrinkles, eye bags, tired texture, or middle-aged features.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: game selection menu, floating icons, text, leader face swaps. Avoid old Rhea, middle-aged Rhea, tired priestess face, wrinkles, eye bags. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
risk_notes: Protect house leader / Blue Lions identity in motion.
